title: Eventual flatness and proper support for one chosen module
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder and $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram of Noetherian rings. Let $c$ be a limiting cone of the opposite diagram of spectra, with affine point $S$. Fix $i\le j$, a finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and a finitely presented module $M$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] on $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ [def-pc-base-change]. Assume its tensor pullback to $X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$ is flat over $S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over] and has support proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then there is $k\ge j$ such that, for every $l\ge k$, the tensor pullback of this same $M$ to $X_l$ is flat over $\operatorname{Spec}(R_l)$ and has support proper over $\operatorname{Spec}(R_l)$. No complex, differentials, or newly chosen module are part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Put f_j = pullback.snd f (Spec(R_j -> R_i)). Its finite-presentation, quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness follow by base change. The map from the displayed limit source to X_j is baseChangeMap, whose square with f_j and the cone projection at j is cartesian. Apply lem-pc-flat-module-descent-preorder to the fixed module M on X_j and this square. This gives k_f >= j and flatness in every cartesian model at every l >= k_f.

Transfer proper support between cartesian models using their comparison isomorphism. In detail, tensor pullback along a cartesian square preserves proper support: pull the closed support back, identify its underlying set by the finite-type support-pullback theorem, base change a proper closed subscheme structure, and use independence of that structure. For the model comparison the upper map is an isomorphism and the lower map is the identity. Tensor-pullback composition and the projections of the comparison isomorphism identify the modules. Module isomorphisms preserve nonzero-stalk support because they induce isomorphisms on every stalk. Finite presentation of each pulled module follows by identifying tensor pullback with the native left adjoint, whose pullback preserves finite presentation. Apply proper-support descent to M on X_j in its canonical cartesian model, giving k_p >= j.

Choose a directed common upper bound k of k_f and k_p. For l >= k the flatness conclusion applies directly to the baseChangeMap square from X_l to X_j. Transfer proper support at k_p to the chosen model X_{k_p} by the preceding comparison. Its module is finitely presented by tensor/native adjoint uniqueness. Preserve its proper support in the cartesian baseChangeMap square from X_l to X_{k_p}. The composition of the maps X_l -> X_{k_p} -> X_j equals X_l -> X_j, because the underlying spectrum maps compose and the functor baseChangeMap preserves composition. The tensor-pullback composition isomorphism identifies the resulting module with the direct pullback of M. Transfer proper support through this module isomorphism and pair it with flatness. Proof irrelevance identifies the proofs of j <= l in the two conclusions.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_eventually_chosen_module_flat_proper
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (M : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
      (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj M).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i))))
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver
      (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i)))
      ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj M)) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k), ∀ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l),
      let hjl := hjk.trans hkl
      let B := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjl)))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjl)))
          (by simp [← Functor.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]))
      (B.obj M).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjl))))) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjl)))))
        (B.obj M)
